description: The pie chart illustrates the distribution of data sources contributing to the combined training set used in the study, with each slice representing a distinct dataset and its proportional contribution. The largest segment, colored blue, corresponds to NQ (Natural Questions), accounting for 31.3% of the training data. The second largest, in teal, is FEVER at 16.1%, followed by SNLI in orange at 15.4%, and MULTINLI in red at 11.3%. VITAMINC, in light blue-green, contributes 13.0%, while XSUMHUL, in a pale cyan, makes up 1.6%. Smaller segments include MULTIFIC and PUBHEALTH, both at 0.5%, SCITAIL at 1.2%, ENTFA at 1.8%, FACTCC at 2.6%, and ANLI at 4.6%. The smallest slice, SCIFACT, is barely visible at 0.1%. Each segment is labeled with its dataset name and percentage, and the slices are arranged in descending order of size clockwise from the top, with no exploded or emphasized segments. The chart provides a clear visual breakdown of how the training data was sourced across multiple benchmarks and corpora.
